title: POSTERIOR PARADE
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. HIPS, GLUTES, BACK. FIFTEEN MINUTES. NO EXCUSES.
intro: LISTEN UP YOU MAGNIFICENT DESK ORNAMENT. WEDNESDAY IS THE BACKSIDE OF THE BODY. HIPS. GLUTES. THAT POSTURE YOU LEFT IN NINETEEN NINETY-EIGHT. PHONE DOWN. CHAIR READY. WE ARE FIXING THE HINGE.
completion: THAT IS THE POSTERIOR DONE. YOU STILL HAVE A BACK. WATER. THEN SIT LIKE SOMEONE WHO OWNS A SPINE. I SHALL SEE YOU TOMORROW FOR INTERVALS. TRY NOT TO FUSE TO THE KEYBOARD.

exercises.name: MARCH ON THE SPOT
exercises.instruction: FORTY-FIVE SECONDS. KNEE UP. ARMS PUMPING. WARM THE HIPS BEFORE WE ASK THEM TO WORK. YOU ARE NOT A COAT RACK.
exercises.midCue: HIGHER. STOP NEGOTIATING WITH YOUR SHOELACES.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY SECONDS. SOFT KNEES. HANDS ON THIGHS. HIP HINGES.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP HINGES
exercises.instruction: TEN. PUSH THE HIPS BACK LIKE YOU ARE CLOSING A CAR DOOR WITH YOUR ARSE. SOFT KNEES. FLAT BACK. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. THIS IS NOT A TOE-TOUCH CONTEST.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY-FIVE. ON YOUR BACK. GLUTE BRIDGES. YES, YOUR ARSE HAS A SHIFT.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGES
exercises.instruction: TWELVE. FEET FLAT. LIFT THE HIPS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP LIKE YOU ARE PINCHING A TENNER AND I AM NOT BUYING YOU A PINT IF YOU DROP IT.
exercises.completeCue: ENOUGH THEATRE. ROLL TO YOUR SIDE AND GET UP.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY-FIVE. ALL FOURS. BIRD DOG. LOOK SILLY. STAY ALIVE.

exercises.name: BIRD DOG
exercises.instruction: FIFTY SECONDS. OPPOSITE ARM AND OPPOSITE LEG. SLOW. HIPS LEVEL. IF YOU WOBBLE THAT IS THE TRAINING, NOT A PERSONALITY CRISIS.
exercises.midCue: SWITCH SIDES. STILL SLOW. THIS IS NOT A RACE WITH A SPANIEL.
exercises.endCue: KNEES DOWN. WELL DONE YOU ODD LITTLE AEROPLANE.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY. WALL. ANGELS. POSTURE OR I SHALL BE LOUD.

exercises.name: WALL ANGELS
exercises.instruction: FORTY-FIVE SECONDS. BACK ON THE WALL. HEAD, ARSE, AND SHOULDERS TOUCHING. SLIDE THE ARMS UP AND DOWN. UNDO THE DESK HUNCH OR I WILL MOCK YOU IN PUBLIC.
exercises.midCue: KEEP THE CONTACT. RIBS DOWN. I AM WATCHING.
exercises.endCue: ARMS DOWN. STEP OFF. FLOOR NEXT.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY. FACE DOWN. SUPERMAN HOLDS. BACKSIDE OF THE BACK.

exercises.name: SUPERMAN HOLDS
exercises.instruction: THIRTY SECONDS. ON YOUR BELLY. LIFT CHEST AND THIGHS A WHISPER OFF THE FLOOR. ARMS FORWARD OR BY YOUR SIDES. BREATHE. DO NOT TURN THIS INTO A YOGA PHOTO.
exercises.midCue: STILL UP. SOFT NECK. I SAID WHISPER, NOT LAUNCH.
exercises.restCue: TWENTY. CHAIR IN REACH. SINGLE-LEG STAND. BALANCE.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND
exercises.instruction: FORTY SECONDS. TWENTY A SIDE. HOLD THE CHAIR. STAND ON ONE FOOT. SOFT KNEE. EYES ON A SPOT THAT IS NOT YOUR SCREEN.
exercises.midCue: SWITCH LEGS. STILL HOLDING. HEROICS CAN WAIT A MONTH.
exercises.endCue: BOTH FEET. THAT IS BALANCE, NOT BALLET.
